name: Pattern map multi-match
description: No sender/recipient filtering. Exercises attachment_pattern_map_step's multi-match behavior directly on top-level attachments (no archive step, so it runs without the '7z' binary): 'monthly_report_FINAL.csv' matches two pattern_map entries at once ('*_FINAL.csv' and 'monthly_*.csv') and gets saved twice, once under each resolved name; 'monthly_summary.csv' matches only the 'monthly_*.csv' entry and is saved once; 'readme.txt' matches the '*.txt' entry but that entry's template is left empty, so it's matched-but-skipped (no save, no crash); 'irrelevant.pdf' matches nothing, so 'matched_attachments' is an empty list and the branch just continues to the next attachment. The 'monthly_*.csv' template includes '${attachment_name}' (the source basename, set by the outer foreach) so the two different source files don't collide on the same output name and overwrite each other. Use with example-data/emails/pattern_map_multi_match.eml.
